description: Deletes items from a collection, by explicit ids or by a Directus query, permanently. Requires confirm: true, and passing neither ids nor query deletes nothing. ids and query are mutually exclusive. Since Directus 12.4 a query resolves its targets under the read permissions of the token: read access to the primary key is required and only readable items are deleted, so the deleted count can be lower than the matching count. Use { "limit": -1 } in query to deliberately target every item. cascadeDelete also removes related items and works only with ids. Use delete_collection to drop the whole collection instead.

query.description: Directus query selecting the items to delete, e.g. { "filter": { "status": { "_eq": "archived" } } }. Mutually exclusive with ids. Use { "limit": -1 } to deliberately target every item.

name: delete_items
